_doc: Loose pipe tables (bare `a | b | c` lines, no outer pipes, no separator row) are rewritten into GFM tables before Markdown parsing. Implementations: orb/src/pipeTables.ts (normalizeLoosePipeTables), iOS OrbPipeTables.normalize, Android OrbPipeTables.normalize; each test replays every case and compares `output` exactly. Rules are documented at the top of orb/src/pipeTables.ts. An all-empty header row means the block had no header; renderers hide it. Numeric columns get a `---:` separator; renderers use tabular figures.

cases.name: header row then prose without a blank line
cases.input:
a | b | c
x | 1 | 2
That is all.

cases.name: mixed column counts are not a table
cases.input:
a | b | c
d | e | f | g
h | i
cases.output:
a | b | c
d | e | f | g
h | i

cases.name: single line is not a table
cases.input: This is a | b | c in a sentence.
cases.output: This is a | b | c in a sentence.

cases.name: pipes inside code fences are untouched
pipes inside inline code are not separators
cases.input:
`a | b` | c | d
`e | f` | g | h
cases.output:
`a | b` | c | d
`e | f` | g | h

cases.name: pipes without surrounding spaces are prose
GFM table without outer pipes is unchanged
list items are not rows
cases.input:

- d | e | f
cases.output:

- d | e | f
